page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. Italic/roman distinction in the body is read from the scan and may be imperfect for some names and numerals (Lectores, Legentes, Maistrife, Licence, Doctorat, Biblio-theque Royale, Roman, Leon IV, Benoist III, 1138, 3 are set roman or uncertain).
